author: Marina
text:
Igor, Sofa, thank you so much for an incredible adventure and unforgettable emotions at the regatta! It was my first experience and it mattered to me that I would be taught and supported. You did that 1000%! I want to keep going and keep getting better! I'd especially like to mention how great you are with the team, how you find an approach to everyone, bring people together and organise them. With you it was easy and fun even when everything seemed to be against us: rain, strong wind or no wind at all, nothing spoiled our adventure.
I will definitely come back again and I recommend you to everyone who wants to try their hand at sailing!
